title: AC1027 consumed-style MLINE offset edits across selected element counts with cap flags

scope.route: Direct edit of one source-bound consumed MLINESTYLE; element count and all non-offset tuple fields remain unchanged.
scope.encoding_matrix: Each selected positive profile covers ASCII and binary input crossed with ASCII and binary output.
scope.runtime_fixture: Runtime-authored test inputs extend the existing two-consumer recipe. No DWG/DXF fixture file was added to Git.

rules.group71: Bit 1 indicates vertices; bit 2 closes the MLINE; bits 4 and 8 suppress start and end caps.
rules.group41: Per-element segment/intersection parameters are recomputed from offsets, justification, vertex directions and miters.
rules.limitation: The specification supports field projection; native cap appearance is not independently qualified.

implementation.admission: The selected AC1027 consumed-style direct offset route now accepts equal source/target element counts from 2 through 255 for group-71 values 5, 9 or 13. It retains the existing geometry, provider, flag and transaction checks. Other versions, counts beyond 255, closed profiles, unknown bits, appends, removals and retargets are controlled by their separate routes.
implementation.projection: The selected source edits the first ordered group-49 offset from 1.25 to 1.5 while retaining all other offsets, ACI colors, linetype names, fill state, two MLINE consumers and their 3-vertex geometry. The writer emits remapped group-340 references, exact MLINESTYLE group-49/62/6 tuples, MLINE groups 71/72/73/74/75, and recomputed group-41 values.
implementation.physicalAndReadbackProof: The runtime oracle checks the emitted style tuple order and values, remapped style handle shared by both consumers, per-vertex group-41 parameters and zero fill counts. Fresh typed readback checks every style offset/color/linetype, style identity, consumer geometry, flags, references, miters and parameter arrays.
implementation.failureAndRetry: At counts 3 and 255, closed group-71 value 3 and unknown-bit value 17 refuse for ASCII and binary output with destination preservation. Corrected group-71 value 13 succeeds through the same writer. Late consumer-parameter mutation at counts 3 and 255 refuses with destination preservation and then succeeds after caller-state restoration and same-adapter retry.

validation.diffCheck: PASS git diff --check before code commit

limits: Boundary tests sample counts 3, 4, 8, 32, 128, 254 and 255; the prior RPP-5wb receipt covers count 2. Intermediate counts are admitted by the same-count implementation gate but are not individually enumerated in this receipt.
This is selected runtime-authored DXF transport and transaction evidence, not an independent native rendering result or real producer-file qualification.
Other direct offset values, other vertex/justification/source profiles, native cap appearance, full document closure and format-support claims remain unqualified.
